label: No infinite PER_SE_5 regress of actual causes of being, from no infinite regress (inference)
rule: A subrelation of a well-founded relation is well-founded
meaning: Strength order (not a route step): the unrestricted regress premise fd12ad3d (well-foundedness of every actual cause of being) implies its per se version for every per se link, since per se actual causes of being are actual causes of being. Strictness: PerAccidensRegressControl satisfies the per se version while fd12ad3d fails; that witness uses an empty per se link, so how much weaker the per se version is depends on the intended meaning of the primitive AsCaused.
